claim: Public snapshot is not a reproducible full C sharp build
decision: Block production warfare until audit build and baseline tests pass

claim: Existing architecture has domain registry service registry and durable intent-resolution-signal patterns
decision: Extend existing seams instead of replacing them

claim: Current combat is primarily air threat and strategic counterattack without operational ground or naval layers
City production chains and transport costs should feed defense readiness
decision: Use one shared production logistics graph

claim: Naval invasion legibility requires preparation convoys sea control and air cover
Militia casualties must affect labor and households
decision: Recruit population cohorts rather than abstract manpower only

claim: Hexagonal boundaries allow headless testing and Unity isolation
decision: Use ports at Unity native UI and offline tool boundaries

claim: Blanket event sourcing adds avoidable complexity
decision: Use snapshots plus command and coarse-outcome journal

claim: FlatBuffers supports Rust C sharp TypeScript and Python schema generation
decision: Pin compiler and runtimes with schema conformance CI

claim: Fixed-point authority and canonical hashing are necessary for replay
decision: Prohibit floating point in hashed authoritative state

claim: Petgraph and rstar provide mature graph and spatial primitives
decision: Wrap behind domain ports and deterministic ordering

claim: Existing Rust HTN crates are not mature enough for the strategic planner
decision: Implement small domain HTN kernel and borrow published concepts

claim: Runtime neural agents are opaque and costly for this scale
decision: Use HTN utility behavior trees and influence maps

claim: GPL references can be adopted only with an intentional license change
decision: Default reference-only; relicense only after dedicated ADR and provenance audit

claim: Mojo Vale Nim Pony and similar languages do not justify shipped runtime ownership
decision: Keep production runtime to C sharp Rust and TypeScript
